description: This PHP test class performs unit testing for the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on API endpoints related to work shift employees. It includes test cases for retrieving all records, and for API methods like create, delete, and their validation rules, which are expected to be unimplemented exceptions.

classes.name: WorkShiftEmployeeAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the WorkShiftEmployeeAPI endpoints, including fetching all records and exception handling for unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all work shift employee records via the API, using data providers for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetAll method, sourcing test cases from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that invoking the create method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to retrieve validation rules for 'create' throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that invoking the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that retrieving validation rules for 'delete' throws a not implemented exception.
